Expense.title: Expense
Expense.description: An expense record extracted from a bank transfer slip or entered manually by an authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user who owns this expense record.

merchantName.description: The recipient or merchant name on the slip (1 to 120 characters).

bankName.description: The bank or payment channel name (1 to 80 characters).

amount.description: The expense amount in THB (> 0 and <= 100000000).

transactionDate.description: Formatted transaction date and time from the slip (1 to 50 characters).

referenceNo.description: Bank transaction reference code from the slip (0 to 100 characters).

memo.description: Optional note or AI summary for the transaction (0 to 300 characters).

isFromSlip.description: Whether this expense was extracted from a bank slip image.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

UserBudget.title: UserBudget
UserBudget.description: Monthly spending budget setting for an authenticated user.

userId.description: The UID of the authenticated user.

monthlyLimit.description: Monthly budget target in THB (>= 0 and <= 100000000).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the budget was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/expenses/{expenseId}.description: Stores user expense records extracted from bank slips or entered manually.

/budgets/{userId}.description: Stores per-user monthly budget target keyed by userId.
